cohort: Women with low-risk pregnancies who gave birth at a large public hospital between 2012 and 2015 and had at least one prenatal visit before 20 weeks gestation
finding: Among low-risk pregnancies, midwife-led care was associated with lower risks of cesarean and preterm birth compared to physician-led care.
mod_finding: Women receiving midwife-led care had lower risks of cesarean and preterm birth compared to those under physician-led care.
